messages:
marie: Hey team — trying to close Milestone Health POC. Customer is asking for a compact 'attestation + test' bundle we can hand to their auditors. They want SOC2 artifacts, pen-test letter, and temporary staging creds for a weekend run. Can we assemble?
dan (Solutions): We can do a POC bundle. Need clarity: do they want a signed pen-test letter (third party vendor) or a self-attestation?
marie: They explicitly asked for a vendor-signed pen-test letter. Legal flagged that as typical. Customer asked if we can provide staging credentials scoped to only the POC dataset.
dan (Solutions): For staging creds we can spin up a short-lived dedicated env or scoped API key with limited model & rate caps. Will need team to approve conv-env quota and network rules.
anita (Security): Vendor-signed pen-test letter — we don't have a recent 3rd-party letter on file for every customer. We can request a pen-test attestation from our contracted pentester, but turnaround is ~2 weeks and there's a fee. Alternatively we can provide our SOC2 report and our internal vuln scan report plus a signed attestation from Redwood security. Which does the customer prefer?
marie: They indicated the vendor-signed is preferred, but they said if turnaround is fast a Redwood-signed attestation plus SOC2 + vuln snapshot might suffice. Their audit lead is flexible but wants documentation to show we've completed external testing in the last 12 months.
sam (Sales Ops): Pricing note — if we spin a short-lived dedicated POC instance we need to price for reserved capacity or offer a timeboxed dedicated uplift. Recommend quoting a 1-week reserved at a small flat fee instead of on-demand to simplify billing. Do we have an internal POC discount for this?
dan (Solutions): For the technical side: I'll prepare the limited-scope API key and a runbook with commands and sample prompts. Example creds TTL: 72h by default; can request 168h for their weekend. I'll include exact ip allowlist instructions.
anita (Security): I'll pull our SOC2 cover letter, the latest pen-test summary (redacted), and a vuln snapshot export. I can also draft a Redwood-signed attestation that says: "We have engaged [VendorName] for periodic penetration testing; vulnerability snapshot taken on [date]; POC environment will be scoped and ephemeral." Will need Legal to sign the pen-test letter if we ask the vendor to produce one for this engagement.
audit-bot: [automated message] Compliance request created: CR-2026-458. Assignee: anita. SLA window: 10 business days.
marie: Customer deadline: they want evidence to present to procurement by next Friday EOD. Is there any way to accelerate?
anita (Security): We can fast-track a Redwood-signed attestation + SOC2 + vuln snapshot this week. Vendor letter is unlikely in that timeframe unless vendor prioritizes (possible but not guaranteed). I'll ask the vendor for expedited turnaround and share ETA.
sam (Sales Ops): For pricing I'll propose: (a) POC dedicated week — $2,500 flat; (b) scoped API key — free but with strict rate limits; include both options in the quote. Marie, pick which to offer first.
marie: Offer the scoped API key + Redwood attestation first (to hit their deadline). Put the dedicated week as an optional paid uplift if they need throughput testing.
dan (Solutions): Copy that. I'll prepare the runbook and scoped creds today, include ip allowlist instructions, sample cURL, and TTL note. cURL sample:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_POC_KEY" \\
  -d '{"input":"test prompt"}' \\
  https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate
```
marie: Thanks — once anita uploads the attestation and SOC2 files I can drop into their procurement packet. Please @mention me when CR-2026-458 gets updated.
anita (Security): Will do. One more ask: Dan, redact logs in the vuln snapshot for customer-sensitive PII before sharing.
dan (Solutions): Will redact and provide checklist of what was redacted.
audit-bot: [automated message] CR-2026-458 status updated: attestation draft uploaded by anita.
marie: Awesome — I'm going to tell the customer we'll provide the attestation + SOC2 + scoped creds today and the vendor pen-test ETA tomorrow. Fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers:
sam (Sales Ops): I'll add the optional pricing addendum and TTL terms to the quote.
anita (Security): Uploading attestation and SOC2 redacted zip to secure dropbox now; sharing link to procurement channel when ready.
marie: Great team — please keep updates short here. I'll confirm once procurement ack'd receipt.
(END)
